summary: Quanta Services filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $2.0 billion aggregate senior notes in three tranches: $500M 4.850% notes due 2029, $750M 5.300% notes due 2033, and $750M 5.550% notes due 2036, sold via an underwriting agreement with BofA Securities, Wells Fargo, J.P. Morgan, PNC, and Truist. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, paying semi-annual interest. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No change of control, tender, or strategic event is involved. Watch for ordinary SEC reporting; no risk-arb angle.
